If you want to sell digital products but keep getting stuck at ‘WHAT would I actually sell?’ Start simple. 7 beginner-friendly ideas: ✨ Checklists ✨ Planners ✨ Trackers ✨ Canva templates ✨ Beginner guides ✨ Resource lists ✨ Workbooks But here's the part I'd pay most attention to: Don't create a random product just because you've seen somebody else selling it. Start with a PROBLEM. Who are you helping? What are they struggling with? What could make that problem quicker, easier or less overwhelming? Instead of: ‘I'll create a meal planner.’ Try: ‘I'll create a simple meal planner for busy women who don't have time to decide what to cook every night.’ Specific problem → specific person → more useful product. Your first digital product doesn't need to be groundbreaking.
